crossRefs.note: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
About ten days later, Yahweh struck Nabal, so that he died.

Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.

people.name: Abijah
people.line: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

translations.web: Jeroboam didn’t recover strength again in the days of Abijah. Yahweh struck him, and he died.
translations.bsb: Jeroboam did not again recover his power during the days of Abijah, and the LORD struck him down and he died.
translations.kjv: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.
translations.asv: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and Jehovah smote him, and he died.
